set4_windswept_cond_desc: When the equipper triggers <ct color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</ct>, their DMG increases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
set4_anom_prof_cond_desc: When the equipper uses an <ct color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</ct>, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 25, stacking up to 2 times, and lasting 40s; repeated triggers reset the duration.
